alignments.note: Indefinite interrogative rendered by the antecedent 'That'.
Relative particle rendered 'which'; each morpheme holds a word of its own, so rule 2 splits the pair.
Finite הָיָה rendered by the copula of the relative clause; the margin's 'Or, hath been' was read and set aside (rule 38).
Predicate adjective rendered 'far off' with the supplied copula; head on the word carrying the lexeme (rules 20, 31).

First member of the emphatic doubling, rendered by the intensifier 'exceeding'; the ASV writes a separate word for each occurrence. Competing reading: mark this occurrence unrepresented under rule 22 and give 'exceeding deep' whole to the second.
Second member of the doubling, rendered 'deep'.
Finite verb with its modal and phrasal particle, discontinuous around the object pronoun (rules 25, 44).
Object suffix rendered by the pronoun (rule 18).

review_notes: The doubled ʿāmōq is given one English word each; the alternative of treating the first as an unrendered repetition is named in that unit's note.
מַה־שֶּׁ is split rather than fused, since 'That' and 'which' each answer to one morpheme.
